summary: pkill -f 'kiln serve' over ssh kills the ssh process itself (its argv contains the pattern), returning rc=255. Use pgrep -x kiln instead — exact name match avoids the ssh wrapper.
blast_radius: any bash script that wraps a pkill command over ssh, ~30 min debug per occurrence
discovered_in: pi-failure-triage 50loop, iter 1 train step bailed silently

summary: cuda_grpo_ablation example does NOT take --kl-coeff / --clip-epsilon / --advantage-mode. The advantage formulation comes from --mode {phase1, phase1_gspo, phase1_cispo, phase1_reinforce}. LossConfig::default() values are baked in. Cap scripts assuming generic GRPO CLI flags will fail.
blast_radius: every cap that builds its own drive script and assumes generic flags

summary: cuda_grpo_ablation enforces --no-echo XOR --echo-lambda mutex. Cap scripts that always pass --echo-lambda by default and conditionally add --no-echo will fail with 'mutually exclusive' error. Fix: build a single ECHO_ARG variable, switch its value based on NO_ECHO flag.

pi 0.75.3 emits role='toolResult' in session JSONL (vs 0.75.1's role='tool'). kiln chat template only accepts canonical role set so role MUST be normalized to 'tool' before passing into Trajectory. lib/pi_trajectory.py was patched to handle both formats and normalize the segment role. ALREADY landed in main as commit 84a896eb.
blast_radius: every agentic-grpo cap broke until lib was patched

summary: kiln-pool lease_ttl_seconds=10800 (3h). For long iter loops (50 iters × ~25 min/iter = 20h), this forces mid-run hibernation every ~5-6 iters. After hibernation, re-acquire gives a NEW pod (disk lost). Bootstrap (~10 min sccache-cached) + fresh rollouts (~40 min) per pod cycle = ~50 min wasted per hibernation. Need either lease-ttl-seconds override on ce kiln-pod-acquire OR a way to extend in-flight leases.
blast_radius: ANY all-night agentic-grpo loop with >5 iters

summary: ce kiln-pod-status requires --lease <id>. There is no way to ask 'is pod X currently leased to me and how long left'. To check lease state, must parse `ce kiln-pod-list` JSON manually. Should add ce kiln-pod-current-lease or similar.
blast_radius: any agent that needs to check its own lease state

summary: When run_iter.sh's bg command starts `cd POD_REPO && rm -rf TRAIN_OUT && python3 rollout.py`, the local wait-file process may check TRAIN_OUT/summary.json BEFORE the bg shell does the rm. Result: wait-file returns 'exists' for the stale summary.json, but the actual rollout is just starting. Fix: idempotency check on the LOCAL side must NOT use the same file path the bg's rm targets. Use a separate sentinel.
blast_radius: any bg + wait-file pattern with rm + create on the same path

summary: /tmp/grpo-pod.env is shared across all kiln cap drives in a session. When one drive completes/fails and another starts, the env file gets overwritten with a different pod's id. Long-running batches that re-source the env mid-run end up SSH'ing the wrong pod. Fix: each cap should use its own env file (e.g. /tmp/pft-pod.env, /tmp/pi-doctest-pod.env).
blast_radius: any concurrent cap runs in the same session
